CJK glyphs are double-width in a terminal font, so every translated cell makes the ASCII '|' borders ragged. This hits `help` (headers 'Command','Description' + 10 command descriptions, terminal.js:1167-1192), `ls` (headers 'ID','FILENAME','FILE TYPE'), and `ssh` (headers 'IP','HOSTNAME'). MITIGATION: either keep table cells ASCII, or monkey-patch generateTable with an East-Asian-Width-aware padder. 2) SCRAMBLE EFFECT IS LATIN-ONLY. terminal.js:877 gsap scrambleText: { text: original, chars: "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz " } — Chinese lines scramble into lowercase Latin and visibly change width mid-animation. effectScramble is true on 20 of the 28 shipped styles. MITIGATION: set chars to a CJK pool, or disable effectScramble on Chinese worlds. FONT STACKS: global.css:3 `.terminal-ascii pre { font-family: monospace }`; terminal_cli.hbs:88 and :128 inline `font-family: monospace`; global.css:198 `font-family: inherit`. GOOD NEWS: the style editor exposes a `fontPath` field (form.hbs:222, placeholder 'font/custom.woff2') that loads an arbitrary woff2 as 'terminal-custom-font' and applies it to the whole terminal (terminal.hbs:8-26).
